versions.localizedDescription: - Other improvements and fixes

- New setting "PiP when leaving the player" (Settings → Player, off by default): swiping a live stream or VOD down, or tapping back, opens it in Picture in Picture instead of the mini player
- Picture in Picture: starting it now shrinks the player so you can keep using the app, instead of leaving a black full-screen player to close
- Picture in Picture: the window's expand button now brings the player back full size, on the same video
- A channel's bot commands (Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot, Moobot) are now on its channel page too, so they can be checked while the channel is offline.
- New settings in Settings → General → Customize the app → Chat · banners (all on by default): hide the chat's notification bell, the chat mode badge ("Followers for 10h"…) and the channel points crown; the bell stays on the channel page and channel points open from the chat's ⋯ menu.
- Channel points can be opened from the chat's ⋯ menu whenever the crown isn't shown, landscape included.
- New setting Settings → General → Customize the app → Chat · banners → Special Events (on by default): hide Twitch's own reward campaigns such as "1 Month of Apple TV" while keeping the channel's drops card.
- Other improvements and fixes
- Settings: the app no longer crashes when opening Settings on iOS 18

- Logs are now fully in the app's language: categories, settings changes and details built while the app runs no longer stay in French
- Settings → General: the language list moved to its own page (App language), like iOS's settings
- Swipe from the left edge to go back in Settings, from a category's live channels and from a channel opened from search results
- When the tool that installed the app doesn't allow changing its icon (LiveContainer, GBox…), Settings now says so instead of offering icons that fail
- Followed categories can use compact covers (3 per row, 4 on iPad) and be sorted A → Z, in Settings → General → Customize the app
- In landscape, the full-size player (app's or Apple's) and multi-live now let the home indicator fade after a few seconds, like video apps, instead of keeping it over the picture.
- Multi-live: tap a tile's speaker to hear several videos at once, and long-press it for that tile's volume; tapping a tile still makes it the only one you hear.
- Hide an emote: long-press it in the chat, or "Hide this emote" on its card; it then shows as the typed word, from any source, in the live, VOD and multi-live chat.
- Settings → Chat → Hidden emotes lists them to show them again; the list follows your account and is shared with the website.
- New setting Settings → Chat → Show the message box (on by default): hide it if you only read the chat, the room goes to the messages; channel points and the chat's ⋯ menu stay as small buttons at the bottom right.
- Rewinding into a live's recording now brings back your chosen playback speed once you're away from its edge, instead of staying at 1×.
- Apple's player now drops to 1× near the edge of a live recording and shows it, instead of a 2× that didn't actually play.
- The player now checks the speed it really plays at: it applies it again, then shows the real speed if playback still can't keep up.
- Experimental 2.25×, 2.5× and 3× speeds in the ⋯ menu of the player, for the current video; they fall back to 2× as soon as playback can't keep up.
- Closing a channel page opened from the full-size player (name, title or chat) now brings the player back full size instead of shrinking it to the mini player.
- Traditional Chinese interface language (thanks to trend0522)
- Other improvements and fixes

- The backup now carries everything to move between the app and TU Test: pinned channels, all settings (appearance, notifications, player, downloads…), the customization and Continue watching, never your Twitch sign-ins
- Importing a backup asks Everything or Channels only, then lists what was restored
- Long-press a video in Continue watching to resume it or remove it from the list
- Settings → About shows the build number next to the version (tap to copy)
- When an install tool put an old build under the latest version's number, the update alert explains how to reinstall and links to the right IPA
- The app now follows iOS's text size (up to Accessibility 2), live: Home, Discover, search, channel pages, settings and chat messages get bigger
- Other improvements and fixes
- Improvements and fixes
- Channel points: the app now joins raids with your Twitch session, so you get the raid bonus like on twitch.tv

- Player: with Higher qualities on and no sub or Turbo, 1440p now plays through your account, switching by itself to the ad-free 1080p source during Twitch ad breaks and back afterwards
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes

- Settings: the top streams language list (and the Categories language menu) scrolls again while a VOD or a live plays in the background
- Chat: the emote picker's channel tab now lists the channel's own Twitch emotes, with the sub emotes you don't have greyed out behind a lock
- Player: when the installer removed Live Activity support, the app stops asking for one until its next launch instead of filling the log
- Player: new Higher qualities setting (off by default) asks Twitch for 1440p and above, in HEVC or AV1 when the device decodes them, on the ad-free stream through your account
- Other improvements and fixes

- Settings → About now credits the people who contribute to the app
- Japanese interface language (thanks to kinboy56)
- Other improvements and fixes

- Player: the zoom level no longer shows up under the pause button
- Other improvements and fixes

- Smoother swipe-down to minimize the player (thanks to dwojc6)
- Italian interface language (thanks to Domenico-lel)
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes

- Live chat now waits for the video: messages show up when the picture catches up, following stalls and jumps back to live (tap the ⏱ badge above the chat for real-time chat)
- Other improvements and fixes

- Customize: reorder and hide the tabs of a channel page (VODs, Highlights, Playlists, Clips, Schedule, About); the page opens on the first one shown
- Tap the tab you're on again to scroll back to the top (Home, Search, My VODs) or to Discover's first page
- Home: pinned channels' live streams stay on top of Following, now sorted by viewers among themselves (Settings → Customize → Pinned sorted by viewers)

- Channel schedule now loads without an account (Twitch's public schedule query)
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes

- Settings: signed in, your settings now follow your Twitch account on the website and your other devices: chat settings, top streams language, VOD speed, pinned and hidden channels, and the app's customization (Settings → Twitch Account → Sync my settings, on by default)
- Settings: language, quality, mobile data, notifications, downloads and appearance stay specific to each device; the latest change wins, and pinned or hidden lists changed on two devices are merged

- Search: typing text now shows results in tabs (Channels, Categories, Live by title or tags, VODs); live streams and VODs from hidden channels or categories are left out, and links or IDs still open directly
- Search: your last 10 searches are listed under the search field, each removable, or clear them all
- Channels: a Schedule tab lists a channel's upcoming streams in your local day and time, with length, title, category, weekly ones and vacation
- Channels: an offline channel's page shows its next scheduled stream (or its vacation) right under its name

- Player: Share in the ⋯ menu sends a VOD (or a rewound live) at the current time, the channel during a live, or the clip's link
- Player: Create a clip during a live from the ⋯ menu, with your Twitch web session (connect it from there if needed), then copy or share its link
- Notifications: live notifications show the stream's thumbnail, are grouped per channel, and offer Watch and Stop notifying for this channel
- Notifications: a bell on channel pages and next to Follow above the chat turns live notifications on or off for that channel
- Chat: tapping a message opens the person's card (badges, account creation date, follow date when Twitch gives it, Mention, Hide and Channel buttons), then their recent messages and the reply thread

- Home: a new "Continue watching" row shows the VODs you started (up to 10, latest first) with their progress; a tap resumes where you stopped (hide it in Settings → General → Customize the app)
- Player: when the connection comes back after a drop, a player stopped on Retry (or on a loading error) and failed multi-live tiles restart on their own, once
- Downloads: the download sheet shows the estimated size and the free space, and refuses with a clear message when there isn't enough room
- Downloads: new "Download on Wi-Fi only" option (Settings → Player, or in the download sheet; off by default): downloads wait for Wi-Fi, then resume on their own
- Downloads: paused downloads now show a Resume button (▶), failed ones Retry (⟳)
- Apple TV: a "Continue watching" row at the top of Following lists the VODs started on this Apple TV, with their progress
- Apple TV: during a channel's ad break, a banner explains the purple screen with a countdown to the stream's return

- Discover: hiding a channel or a category now removes it from the feed right away, and the ⋯ menu no longer offers to hide channels or categories you follow
- Discover: coming back to the tab keeps your place, mode and sound (the top is reloaded after 10 minutes)
- Discover: the Clips tab no longer spins forever when the top is empty, and Retry reloads it
- Discover: clip durations show as m:ss instead of "0min"
- Discover: the unfollow confirmation shows the channel's display name
- Discover: previews now pause under every sheet (feedback, reports, downloads, sleep timer)
- Discover: with the mini player or the multi-live bar shown, the game, tags and ⋯ button stay above them
- Home: without an account, the automatic refresh no longer drops the streams loaded with "Load more"
- Your account's followed channels and categories are now loaded at launch whatever the start tab, so Discover never hides them and backups include them
- Channel points: a balance that couldn't be read when the chat opened no longer shows up later as a huge gain
- Chat: a message that couldn't be sent goes back into the input field instead of being lost
- Chat: turning the watch streak or live events back on during a stream now works without reopening the chat
- VOD chat: comments appear within 3.5 s even when 7TV, BTTV or FFZ don't answer
- Logs: the log screen no longer slows down while something is playing
- Downloads: the default quality follows your playback quality, capped at 720p and never audio only
- Player: a second "slow connection" notice now stays its full 4 seconds
- Settings → Channel points: the per-channel list stays smooth with many channels

- Player: the landscape view forced by the rotate button is kept when the stream reloads (refresh, Retry, followed raid, next VOD)
- Player: the Live Activity no longer disappears when following a raid or moving to the next VOD with the screen locked
- Player: a recent VOD opened while AirPlay is on resumes where you left off instead of restarting from 0:00
- Player: dragging the full-broadcast bar to the very start now opens the recording at its beginning instead of the present
- Player: after a playback error, Play from the lock screen or headphones no longer keeps the screen awake or shows the video as playing
- Player: the "live via your account" notice no longer comes back after each "slow connection" quality drop
- Player: a speed forced by the player (caught up with a live recording, AirPlay) no longer resets later VODs to 1x
- Player: the starting quality no longer changes, reloading the stream, when switching between Wi-Fi and cellular
- Player: changing quality during AirPlay no longer leaves the receiver unable to play
- Player: after stalls on cellular, the Live button no longer jumps to the very start of the live window
- Player: a VOD stopped by a muted segment before resuming now restarts at your saved position instead of 0:00
- Multi-live: the screen can sleep again when no tile is playing (all paused, offline, failed or finished)
- Multi-live: a tile cut off mid-playback now gets its 3 retries instead of 1 or 2
- Multi-live: on cellular, tiles follow the cellular quality setting instead of starting in 1080p
- Discover: music from another app resumes after closing the player, even when a preview starts right away

- New Settings → General → Customize the app: show, hide and reorder the tabs, and pick the tab the app opens on
- Customize the Home screen: reorder or hide the Followed / Top / Offline tabs, hide the announcement, poll, sign-in and web session cards or the Categories view
- Customize the player's bottom bar: reorder or hide its buttons, add sleep timer, multi-live and rewind buttons, hide AirPlay
- Chat banners: polls, predictions and the hype train can now be hidden one by one

- Chat: the Return key now hides the keyboard instead of sending (the send button is right next to it); Settings → Chat → "Return sends the message" brings the old behavior back
- Chat: tapping the chat while the keyboard is open only hides the keyboard, without opening the message or emote card
- Improvements and fixes
- Discover: opening a live or clip no longer leaves the preview playing underneath (no more double sound)

- Discover: the speaker button turns the preview's sound on and off (lives and clips)
- Discover: tap a channel's name or picture to open its page
- A live opened from Discover now always has sound
- On iPhone the app stays in portrait, except in the player and multi-live where landscape still works

- Discover: the Clips feed loads again (Twitch refused the request)
- Discover: the preview no longer fills and crops the whole screen, and the channel name, title, Follow and side buttons are visible again
